sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
**Unit economics.** 82.9M paid households (Q3 FY26, +4.1% y/y), 148.5M cardholders, 38.7M+ Executive at 2% rebate; renewal 92.2% US/Can, 89.7% worldwide (Q3 FY26 10-Q). Membership fees FY25 $5,323M (10-K), 36wk FY26 $4,057M (+13%). Fee income = 51% of FY25 operating income ($5,323/$10,383M).

**Revenue.** FY25 net sales $269,912M, total revenue $275,235M (10-K). 36wk FY26 net sales $203,374M (+9.6%); Q3 total-company comps +10%, ex-gas/ex-FX +7%; digitally-enabled comps +21%; 23 net new warehouses, 928 total (637 US) (10-Q).

**Margins & leverage.** Merchandise gross margin ~11.1% (FY25); Q3 FY26 gross +1bp and SG&A -2bps ex-gas/ex-FX — operating leverage ON at current comps. Op margin 3.77% (FY25) to ~3.9-4.0% (FY26E).

**Cash.** CFO 36wk FY26 $11,133M vs capex $4,228M → FCF ~$6.9B/36wk; cash+STI $20.0B. Accruals ratio negative 3y (FY25 -7.1%) — cash structurally above NI.

**Estimate (committed, never edited).** FY26E diluted EPS ~$20.5 (+12.6% vs $18.21), FY27E ~$23, FY28E ~$25.5, FY29E ~$28.0. Owner earnings ≈ EPS (FCF/share ~$21).

**Load-bearing assumptions (carry >70% of value), each cited:**
1. **Membership-fee growth ~12-13%/yr** (paid-household +4%, Executive upgrade mix, $65→$130 fee ladder) — drives ~51% of operating income. Source: Q3 FY26 10-Q: "Membership fee revenue increased 11% and 13%... driven by new member sign-ups, membership fee increases and upgrades to Executive Membership"; paid members 82,900 vs 79,600.
2. **Comparable-sales growth ~7% ex-gas/ex-FX** with SG&A/fixed-cost leverage. Source: Q3 FY26 10-Q comp table: Total Company +10%, ex-gas/ex-FX +7%.

Uncited load-bearing assumption: none — both above are filing-sourced.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: From memory, the market narrative is that Costco is the "last great compounder" whose ~40-50x premium is justified by membership-fee economics — bulls "buy the dip," bears say "priced for perfection"; the premium is treated as fragile but the fee stream is not separately priced.

sections.heading: Base-rate anchoring
sections.markdown: The **derated_compounder_rerating** base rate (0.40, +50/-30, 3y) is the honest reference class: this is a premium-multiple quality-compounder story at ~47x FY26E forward, and the archetype's failure mode — a structural de-rating of a premium name — is the live risk. The **dividend_income_anchor** (0.60, +25/-15) does NOT govern the prior: its window is high-payout cash cows whose return is yield-anchored, and Costco's 0.6% regular yield fails that test; the card's "+9% EV" for the dividend framing is a two-point artifact (0.60×25 + 0.40×-15 = +9.0) assigning a yield-capture work-rate to a name that barely yields. Its genuine insight — membership-fee cash flow funds a defensive floor of regular+special dividends and buybacks, truncating the loss tail — is real and justifies p_up at **0.50** (argued +10pp above the 0.40 registry; held below 0.60 by the 47x valuation). Down leg set at -25% (vs archetype -30) because the 92.2% renewal + $20B cash floor caps the realistic loss short of the archetype's mean.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** "Great company, dangerous price." After three headlines (stock -12% off $1,096 high; Brent $94 war premium; consumer-stagflation chatter) the generalist says Costco is a wonderful franchise but 47x forward is too rich for a retailer, so wait for a deeper pullback.

**Why wrong:** The 47x quote mis-prices the mix. ~51% of operating income is contractual, renewal-gated fee revenue (92.2% US/Can), not retail spread — capitalize that stream on its own and the "retail multiple" overstates the entry risk. The business is *accelerating* (Q3 comp +10%, digitally-enabled +21%, fees +13%) into a NEUTRAL-appetite regime that rewards wage-funded domestic consumption; Costco's needs-based basket is insulated from the China-demand/EM-flow channels the desk avoids, and the Fed is on hold near 3.63% effective (easing impulse, Sept-hike odds collapsed 2026-08-22 memo) — supportive of premium-multiple survival. The market cannot hold a 3y view: it sells the -12% sentiment de-rating while EPS compounds to ~$28 by FY29; at a held ~48x, that is $1,344 (+40%) plus the special-dividend floor.

**What proves us wrong:** Renewal rate <90% US/Can; membership-fee growth <5% y/y; two consecutive quarters of negative ex-gas/ex-FX comps (fixed-cost absorption flips to headwind); or a structural de-rate below ~30x forward (price kill at $720 ≈ 26x FY29E). The Q3 +10% comp being gasoline/FX-flattered is a real audit risk — the +7% ex-gas/ex-FX is the metric I'm paid on.

**Edge taxonomy:** time-arbitrage (primary — market can't hold a 3y compounding view through a macro wobble) + analytical (fee stream priced as retail multiple, not contractual annuity).

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. US/Canada renewal 92.2%, worldwide 89.7% (Q3 FY26 10-Q) — moat metric; below ~90% erodes the thesis.
2. Membership-fee revenue +11% Q3, +13% YTD (Q3 FY26 10-Q) — the engine; a stall to <5% is dispositive.
3. Total-company comps +10% Q3 / +7% ex-gas/ex-FX (Q3 FY26 10-Q) — but ex-gas/ex-FX is the honest line; monitor for negative prints.
4. Inventory build $1,240M vs revenue +$17,894M (36wk, 10-Q cash flow) — no overhang; and accruals negative 3y (SEC XBRL: NI<CFO every year) — cash conversion clean.
5. Quarterly dividend raised to $1.47 (Apr 2026, 10-Q); special-dividend cadence (last: $15/sh in FY24, 10-K) supports the floor thesis but has paused — a Dec-2026 special would confirm.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is Aug 2029 and this position lost ~25%. The most likely reason: the war-premium stagflation (Brent >$100) finally reached the US wage-earner; two negative ex-gas/ex-FX comp quarters forced the 47x premium toward ~30x even with membership intact — because at this valuation a de-rating needs no fundamental break, only a growth scare and rotation out of premium US defensives. Second joint: my 0.50 p_up was too high for a 47x entry, and the special-dividend cadence stayed paused, so the "floor" was thinner than modeled. Drew will note the entry multiple; the honest answer is the thesis pays only if the premium *survives* — that is the bet.

sections.heading: Freshness pass
sections.markdown: Price asof 2026-09-01 close $939.96 (yfinance) vs entry $960 = -2.1%, inside max_chase 3%. No material change since 2026-08-26. EDGAR: no Costco 8-K since 2026-07-08 (confirmed). August net-sales / FY26-to-date release: unconfirmed — no release appears in news/IR feeds as of 2026-09-02; latest monthly covered was July (pre-draft). Q4 FY26 earnings 8-K not due until late Sept; no guidance issued. Post-draft headlines (Medicare/SCAN recap, dividend speculation) are non-primary, not filing-confirmed. Re-stamp: **trade levels stand** — kill 720 < entry 960 < target 1344 coherent; -2.1% drift within chase band; ev_math +40/-25 unchanged. Frontmatter untouched.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
(Drew appends verbatim; survives the Judge verdict — never edited by a later stage)

1. Fact-check: no COST dossier/sleeve row; cited FY26 filings not web-retrievable. 51% fee-share is structurally plausible, but every FY26 line item (82.9M households, fee +13%, $5,323M/$10,383M) is analyst-transcribed, unconfirmed.

2. Archetype misapplied: derated_compounder_rerating buys AFTER compression; COST at ~47x FY26E (~42x FY27E; FY26 just closed) has not compressed. Its own note: >30x names through de-rating have a poor base rate. Failure case at peak premium; p_up belongs below 0.40.

3. Multiple-survival test fails: $1,344 ≈ 48x FY29E = entry (42x FY27E → 48x is expansion) — zero margin of safety. +40% rides on EPS compounding at held ~48x on a ~4%-margin retailer (~2% earnings yield vs 8–10% COE). 2022 de-rated ~40x→~28x in months.

4. Fee engine episodic: $65→$130 ladder banked mid-2024; between hikes fees grow ~5–7%, not 13%. At 7%, FY29E EPS ~$25.5, target ~$1,225 (+28%). The <5% fee "kill" is a review trip, so a ~6% stall never triggers.

5. p_up 0.50 double-counts: renewal + cash already set down_pct -25 (vs -30). At honest 0.40 and +40/-25, EV ~+1% (~0.8%/yr) — quarter-Kelly ≈ zero. Clears only on the least-evidenced input.

6. down_pct -25 is the kill floor, not the losing mean: losers breach $720 (still 35x FY26E). A fee-stall cuts EPS and multiple: ~20x on ~$24 ≈ $480 ≈ -50%. Entry 2% above a fallen tape adds uncompensated cost.

7. Variant is risk premium: at ~2% earnings yield the market prices stagflation (Brent ~94 on the US wage-earner — the pre-mortem's top cause). No sum-of-parts proves the blended multiple "should" be 48x.

8. Regime conflict: NEUTRAL balance_of_payments (08-22) — the leg protecting a 47x premium is EM/IDR funding relief, not US-consumer; COST is the wage-funded channel the war premium pressures.

9. No catalyst: catalyst_date null; time-arbitrage with entry above market = full size, no trigger; position sits -2% to -12% for quarters. Watchlist call.

10. Pre-mortem gap + anti-gaming: Executive upgrades self-cannibalize fee MARGIN (2% rebate liability grows with mix) — unmentioned. Anti-gaming clean: estimates precede draft, no anomalies — kill stands on merits.

**Verdict: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** A 47x-forward retailer whose entire target is a ~48x premium surviving three years is the exact bet the fund's de-rating base rate says to avoid — at honest inputs (p_up ≤0.40, down_pct ≤-30) expected value rounds to zero.

**Re-attack (2026-09-02)** — Revision answers all 10 points in substance; none dodged. Decisive concession: #3/#4 — target $1,344 (~48x FY29E) was pure multiple expansion; honest between-hike fee growth puts FY29E EPS ~$25.5, collapsing the long's upside. Arithmetic does NOT reconcile: expected_pct = 0.35×12 + 0.65×(−50) + 1.0 − 0.5 = −27.8, not the stated −25.8 — a 2.0pp error in Sloane's favor (direction unchanged). Levels coherent: kill 480 = −50% off 960 (down_pct −50); target 1070 = +11.5% (up_pct 12); 480<960<1070. Minor residual: fee-growth <5% remains a review trip, but price-kill 480 moots it for sizing. Concession genuine — EV is negative on her own inputs. Verdict: KILL_RECOMMENDED confirmed.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
1. Concede verification gap: no dossier/sleeve row; FY26 lines (82.9M HH, fees +13%, $5,323M/$10,383M) are unconfirmed transcription — the load-bearing fee+comp base is unverified, so p_up and the EPS path come down.
2. Concede archetype misapplied: COST has not compressed; ~47x peak premium runs the >30x de-rating base rate, not derated-compounder rerating. p_up 0.50→0.35 (below the 0.40 registry).
3. Concede multiple-survival failure: $1,344 ≈ 48x FY29E is expansion over a ~42x forward entry; ~2% earnings yield vs 8-10% COE. Target 1344→1070 (≈42x on FY29E ~$25.5); up_pct 40→12.
4. Concede fee engine episodic: between hikes fees run ~5-7%, not 13%; at 7% FY29E EPS ≈ $25.5, not $28 — target re-based on $25.5.
5. Concede p_up 0.50 double-counted (renewal+cash already set down_pct). At honest 0.35 with +12/-50, EV ≈ -26% — no quarter-Kelly trade.
6. Concede down_pct -25 was the kill floor, not the losing mean: a fee-stall re-rates ~20x on ~$24 ≈ $480 ≈ -50%. down_pct -25→-50; kill 720→480.
7. Concede variant is risk premium, not edge: at ~2% earnings yield the market already prices the stagflation my pre-mortem named.
8. Concede regime conflict: NEUTRAL BoP relief is EM/IDR funding; it does not protect a 47x US wage-funded premium consumer name, and Brent ~94 pressures it.
9. Concede no catalyst, entry above market: time-arbitrage with no trigger was idle full-size risk — demote to watchlist.
10. Concede Executive upgrades self-cannibalize fee margin (2% rebate liability scales with mix) — unmodeled. Anti-gaming clean.

ev_math changed (>20% rel each → Drew re-attack): p_up 0.50→0.35, p_down 0.50→0.65, up_pct 40→12, down_pct -25→-50, expected 10.0→-25.8. Levels now 480<960<1070. Honest EV is negative — long no longer supported; franchise intact, price/structure fail the de-rating base rate.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**Verdict: KILL** (reason_tag: `valuation`).

I rule on the arithmetic first, and it is dispositive before the franchise is weighed: on Sloane's own conceded inputs the honest EV is negative — 0.35×12 + 0.65×(−50) + 1.0 − 0.5 = −27.8% — and I correct frontmatter `expected_pct` from the stated −25.8 to −27.8 (2.0pp in the analyst's favor; per the 2026-08-22 WEEKLY_DEEP precedent on T-GLOBAL-0700HK-001, correcting more negative is not gaming). No p_up within argued distance of the 0.40 registry makes this trade positive: EV breaks even only near p_up ≈ 0.80 on a ~47x-forward retailer. Grounds: (1) This archetype buys AFTER compression (the base-rate library — "base rate of holding a >30x name through de-rating is poor"); COST has not compressed, the analyst conceded the misapplication, and p_up 0.35 sits below registry — which only deepens the negative EV. (2) Zero margin of safety: conceded target 1070 ≈ 42x FY29E ~$25.5 is a held forward multiple, not a discount; ~2% earnings yield vs 8–10% COE means the premium must survive, not recover. (3) The asymmetry is wrong-way: −50% down (kill 480 ≈ 20x) against +12% up, and the franchise quality (92.2% renewal, $20B cash) is already inside that −50 losing mean — it truncates nothing. (4) No catalyst, entry above the 939.96 tape, and the BoP-pressure/NEUTRAL regime does not protect a war-premium-pressured US wage-funded premium name. Drew's strongest sentence survives restated in my own words: a thesis whose entire target is a premium multiple merely persisting for three years, with EV negative on the conceding analyst's own numbers, is precisely what the de-rating base rate exists to screen out.
